name: postulo-thunderbird
description: Thunderbird extension for Postulo: job postings from your mail to your own Postulo. A skeleton for now.

scripts.lint: npm run stage && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/src
scripts.build: npm run stage && web-ext build --source-dir dist/src --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename postulo-thunderbird-{version}.xpi
scripts.start: npm run stage && web-ext run --source-dir dist/src --firefox thunderbird
